en: Steel yourselves! Summoning a being this powerful is seldom done with positive results.
%s is destroyed. Aerial assault unable to confirm strike point. Mission aborted.

Have you seen all the wonderful things here in Ungoro Crater, $n? It's simply amazing. Not as amazing as some of the things I can make with my skill at engineering, but for it being all natural here... it's not too bad.$B$BMy uncle Remtravel loves old stuff like this place. I'm following in his footsteps kinda--I want to discover new things from lost cultures too!

Such wisdom is steeped in a mystery that can only be found in great Thunder Bluff.  Follow the path north out of Bloodhoof Village until you come to an elevator at the base of the bluffs.  Ride it to the top and ask one of the Bluffwatchers for further assistance.
Yes, we shall!
As a mage, you are one of a select group that can conjure a portal to transport you back to this very place.  I can teach you if you are ready.
Don't see many Blacksmiths this far from Ironforge. What can I do for ye?
%s looks tired. He then yawns and lies down next to A-Me 01
And a great deal of honor you shall have, I am sure.  Speak with Martin Lindsey at the Pools of Vision.  It is a cave located in the side of the Spirit Rise.
The Might of Kalimdor will halt their advances!
I trust the Light is with you, $n. Is there something that I can I help you with?
You were wise to seek me out. I would ask a small favor. In return, there is much I can teach you.
Paltry kill.

The abomination has overrun the Night Watch camp! Quickly, we must intercept it before it reaches town!
Show your appreciation for the arts and drop some coins in my hat!
Now there is only one way out- to walk the lonely path of the damned.
That the fates should be so cruel as to permit us only this after a thousand years apart...

Aye, you there!  If you want to earn the respect of the dwarves of Ironforge, then you can start by donating valuable resources!  Ironforge finds itself running low on cloth piece; textiles and bandages don't grow on trees, ya know!$B$BRather than cash in various cloth pieces you find adventuring, donate them!  Doing so will earn you the recognition of the dwarven people of Ironforge!
Where is Elder Winterhoof?
Sure I can teach you the fine art of wielding a polearm, but it's gonna cost you.
Answer cannot be seen through the twisting nether.
Here we have the Cathedral of Light, the center of spiritual enlightenment here in Stormwind.
Thank you, Mrs. Chambers.
Wind Rider Master
You've been such an unbelievably big help! These bones are going to unlock so much new information and help me futher my research.
Foolish $C!  I will snap the bones of this weak $R!
Ah, you're the one who found the letter. Thank you for the... news, I suppose, about my former family. You're welcome to what food and drink I can offer.
You want a weapon that acts as an extension of your very fist? Yes, I believe I can show you something.
Show me what's for sale.
Please teach me how to become an axesmith, Kilram.
Information on the Skin of Shadow.
Success, the rift is open!! My brethren, rise and return home! The Outland awaits!

The humans built an inn on the edge of the Barrens. The Shady Rest, they called it. Weeks ago, it was burned down.$b$bThe Warchief told us to leave the humans alone, so long as they didn't cross our borders, but it appears someone violated his wishes.$b$bHe has put me in charge of getting to the bottom of it. If you wish to provide assistance, go to the remains of the Shady Rest Inn and return any clues you find to me.
"Khadgar's Mystical Journal, Volume 8." I think this is the one I wanted.
How many battles have we won?

The waters of northern Sar'theris Strand in Desolace or the Angor Fortress in Badlands have locked boxes that can be picked open.
